mechanism: NSAIDs inhibit platelet aggregation and increase bleeding risk; combined with MAOI which can potentiate hypertensive crisis and increase CNS effects; NSAIDs may reduce antihypertensive efficacy of medications used with MAOIs.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use lowest NSAID dose for shortest duration, monitor closely for bleeding and hypertensive symptoms, and consider alternative analgesics (acetaminophen preferred).
